document.title: Smaller diffs on mobile, plus an Iosevka toggle
document.summary: Diff text and file headers scale down on narrow screens, and lines wrap there by default. An Aa toggle beside the theme toggle switches code text between IBM Plex Mono and bundled Iosevka, stored locally.
document.why: The user reports that on mobile the diffs do not get smaller, unlike the sections above them [the session](source:s1).

sources.label: T3 session · Oct 17
sources.gist: User reported mobile diffs stay large and asked for T3-style mobile diffs, then asked to bundle Iosevka with a subtle stored toggle.

parts.name: Mobile diff reading
parts.summary: Diff text, gutter, and file header shrink on narrow screens and lines wrap by default.

parts.name: Mono font choice
parts.summary: Bundled Iosevka sits behind a small Aa toggle with a stored preference.

groups.title: Diff text scales down on mobile
groups.why: The user asked that diffs follow the top sections' font size behavior on mobile [the session](source:s1).
groups.summary: styles.css steps --diff-font-size and --diff-line-height down at 799px, a diffs-container host rule carries them into Pierre, and the mobile gutter slims with them.
lookFor: Subtle: Pierre reads font size on the diffs-container host. The --diffs-font-size rules on inner diff elements do nothing; the host rule in styles.css is the one that must carry the vars.

groups.title: Narrow screens wrap diff lines by default
groups.why: In the user's mobile screenshots, long lines are cut off at the card edge [the session](source:s1).
groups.summary: resolveWrap in narrow.ts defaults wrap on when the screen is narrow, an explicit toggle still wins, and App holds that override.

groups.title: File header gets quiet on mobile
groups.why: The file header crowded out the filename in the user's mobile screenshots [the session](source:s1).
groups.summary: The filename drops to 12px on narrow screens and the hunk count label hides there; the change counts stay.

groups.title: Iosevka as a stored mono choice
groups.why: The user asked to bundle Iosevka as a mono font with a subtle toggle, stored in storage [the session](source:s1).
groups.summary: main.tsx imports @fontsource/iosevka, mono-font.ts and MonoFontProvider hold the stored choice, and an Aa button beside the theme toggle in both headers switches --font-mono.
lookFor: The Iosevka latin woff2 is about 1 MB per weight. The browser downloads it only when Iosevka first applies, because the Aa glyph renders in the current mono font.

commits.subject: Shrink diffs on mobile and add Iosevka mono toggle
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body: Diff text now steps down at the 799px breakpoint via host-level Pierre vars (11px/17px on mobile, 13px/20px on desktop), narrow screens wrap by default with the toggle still winning, and file headers drop the hunk label on mobile. Iosevka ships bundled via @fontsource/iosevka behind a subtle Aa toggle next to the theme toggle; the choice is stored in localStorage.
